name: git_status
description: Show the workspace repository's status in git's porcelain v1 format: the current branch and each staged, modified, or untracked path. Read-only — it never changes the repository.

detailed: Reports the working-tree and staging state of the workspace repository.
friendly: See what has changed in the repo.
whimsical: Take the pulse of the repository.
{source} is checking the pulse of the repo

detailed: tool {participantRole} is reading the repository status

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
